name: STAC Themes Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC Themes extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC Themes extension (thns:schemes, thns:scheme, thns:concepts, and the Concept Object fields thns:id/thns:name/thns:description), providing Linked Data terms for the STAC Themes schema and for the osc schema block, which reuses this namespace. thns:Concept is modeled as a skos:Concept subclass; thns:Theme and the structural properties stay OWL. Preserves pre-existing thns:* term IRIs already relied on by themes-shacl's SPARQL rules.
